settings.minimum_bid_basis: Working assumption; lowest recorded auction purchase is $1. Formal rule not confirmed.
settings.market_age_basis: Recorded historical season age advanced to the auction season. Missing ages use the corresponding statistics-only model; no age is guessed. Age is a pricing feature, not a predetermined youth or keeper premium.

survivor.season_length_basis: NBA calendar October 20, 2026 through April 11, 2027 inclusive; assumes the league uses the full regular season.
survivor.schedule_basis: Illustrative elimination schedules, not confirmed dates or probabilities. Thirteen cuts leave two teams; a two-week cadence throughout would exceed this season's length.
survivor.availability_basis: Published games spread uniformly through the season; dated injuries, NBA game schedules and lineup limits are not available.
survivor.replacement_basis: Balanced neutral rosters: after each cut, replacement depth follows remaining teams times 15 roster slots. Category scores stay on the original scale. Final two teams imply a top-30 pool; this is a scenario, not guaranteed waiver access.
survivor.moves_basis: Neutral pool turnover costs 15 / teams_before_cut expected acquisitions per surviving team. Stop improving replacement depth when the 100-move allowance is exhausted. Actual waivers, sniper picks and move usage are not simulated.
survivor.scoring_basis: Cumulative contribution conditional on reaching the final; no assumed elimination probability or statistics reset.

settings.horizon: Per-game category advantage integrated above rising replacement levels, using published availability and a shared 1,000-game pacing limit.
settings.market_basis: Historical prices use preceding-season per-game stats. Current estimates use published projected per-game stats. Historical preseason projections are unavailable.

league_rules.category_status: Standard eight categories inferred from eight-category roto without turnovers; confirm exact categories.
league_rules.season_mapping_status: Inferred from 11 consecutive league years and matching 2015-16 through 2025-26 tracking tabs.
league_rules.roster_size_status: Observed in 163 of 165 team-seasons; lineup and bench rules unconfirmed.
league_rules.budget_status: Confirmed by the supplied 2026 keeper summary: keeper costs plus remaining budget equal $200 for all 15 teams.
league_rules.target_season_status: 2026 keeper summary supplied for the upcoming 2026-27 season.
league_rules.elimination_schedule: First elimination a month and a bit into the season; then every one or two weeks until two teams remain. Exact dates not supplied.
league_rules.eliminated_player_acquisition_rule: Eliminated rosters enter regular waivers. Unclaimed players enter a sniper draft in reverse original waiver order.
league_rules.waiver_order_rule: Order selected before the season. No team repeats an earlier year's position within the 15-year cycle; reset in year 16. Actual orders not supplied.
league_rules.historical_manager_identity: Sheet names identify franchise histories, not necessarily the manager in older seasons. Tracking headers are preserved separately.

validation.model_selection_basis: Candidate choice uses development-year MAE only. Later seasons have been reviewed during earlier model development and are reused retrospective checks, not fresh independent holdouts.
validation.interpretation: Out-of-season price tests use prior-year actuals, not archived preseason projections. Rookies and low-sample players without prior stats are excluded. Current projection-based estimates are not independently validated.

rate_reference.selection: highest minutes per game among eligible players

market_context.basis: Basketball Reference season ages. Target-season age advances the latest earlier recorded season age by elapsed seasons; no birthdays or rookie ages are guessed.

auction_contexts.budget_basis: $200 starting budget and 15 opening slots per team; historical budget rule assumed constant.

retention_audit.interpretation: Only finalists, classified by preceding-season per-game rank. Matching opening and final snapshots does not prove continuous ownership. This descriptive audit is not used to fit replacement dates or prices.

validation.neutral_value_basis: Equal category weights; linear allocation of positive survivor value above replacement. No historical price fitting, star multiplier or category punt. Scenario estimate, not an empirically validated optimum.
validation.market_price_basis: Conditional on selection at auction; keeper-adjusted discretionary money per open slot; available-talent correction was evaluated but not selected. Individual estimates are not a simultaneous auction allocation. Team budget distribution is displayed, not a simulation of manager bidding.

interval.basis: Absolute normalized out-of-season price errors, grouped by predicted price tier; descriptive error band, not a guaranteed confidence interval.
